Create an EthSigner from a Private Key

Source: R/signer.R
eth_signer.Rd

Returns an EthSigner for the given key. By default the key is read from the ETH_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable so it never appears in code or history; pass private_key explicitly to override.

Usage

eth_signer(private_key = Sys.getenv("ETH_PRIVATE_KEY"))

Arguments

private_key

(scalar<character> | vector<raw, 32>) the signing key, a 0x-prefixed 64-hex string or raw(32). Defaults to Sys.getenv("ETH_PRIVATE_KEY").

Value

(class<EthSigner>) the signer.

Examples

signer <- eth_signer(
  "0x0123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123"
)
signer$address
#> [1] "0x14791697260e4c9a71f18484c9f997b308e59325"
